name: Torr2Jelly
description: TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features direct TorrServer streaming, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Fix Trending now posters stacking vertically on mobile or clients without Jellyfin's optional scroller styles. Explicitly keep a single horizontal, scrollable row while retaining native responsive poster sizes and avoiding the managed itemsContainer lifecycle.

Native Jellyfin styling for Trending now and movie details: matching posters, spacing, typography, theme colors, icons, ratings and cast. Keep Trending directly below library folders. Improve keyboard focus and background refresh. Avoid native list lifecycle conflicts during navigation. Includes the newer-Jellyfin movie-details compatibility fix.

Fix movie details failing on newer Jellyfin versions because the library query return type changed. Existing-library links are optional and cannot break movie details or verified adds. Place Trending now directly below the media-library folders, including when those folders load late.

Trending TMDB movies on the Jellyfin Web home screen, with movie details, cast, IMDb ratings and background Add jobs. Automatic torrent selection requires matching IDs, title, year, info-hash and movie files; otherwise a placeholder is kept. Ukrainian audio hints are preferred; freeleech and seeders are required. Durable quarantine and recovery protect rejected candidates and manual additions.

Add a release from a .torrent file as well as a magnet link: on the admin page (Add torrent tab), and from a movie's or series' page. Files are uploaded to TorrServer, so private-tracker announce URLs and passkeys are kept. Administrators only; files up to 4 MB.
The text areas on the plugin's admin page (bulk titles, magnet links) are styled like Jellyfin's native inputs.

Search shows only freeleech releases by default (one switch in the settings; release-type and tier chips are gone, rows show tracker, size and seeders). Series placeholders, TMDb title lookup with a bulk Placeholders tab, and an admin-only 'add as placeholder' block on Jellyfin's search page. Torrent version rows show size and live seeders instead of the hash tail.

Movie placeholders: titles that have no stream yet can be listed in the library with their poster and metadata. Adding a release from the movie page replaces the placeholder with the real stream. New admin endpoint POST /Plugins/Torr2Jelly/Placeholders.
The search button in the movie and series release dialogs is now aligned with its search field.

Native Jellyfin look: the search page section, the item-page dialogs and the settings page are rebuilt from Jellyfin's own components and theme colors (no external fonts or styles). Series pages can add a release straight into the series' folder, season by season. Regular users can only add magnet links, info-hashes or links from the configured indexers. Rewritten README and MIT license file.

Restore the search and item-page integration on Jellyfin 12.x: the search script is now added to the web client page while it is served instead of patching the read-only index.html. Deleting or replacing alternate versions now also works for items in Jellyfin libraries outside the plugin's categories.
Fix HTTP 401 on the Torr2Jelly settings page with newer Jellyfin servers that disable legacy authorization: the page now sends the standard Authorization header.

Security & data-safety hardening: plugin API now requires Jellyfin login (admin for management), safe .strm cleanup that never deletes outside category folders or when TorrServer is unreachable, alternate versions survive sync, indexer API keys no longer exposed to clients, settings save merges instead of resetting fields, Jellyfin 10.11 scheduled-task compatibility, BaseUrl-safe search integration.

Multi-version and alternate torrent stream support: add alternative torrent releases directly from item details page in Jellyfin Web, slide-out stream management drawer, native Jellyfin multi-version stream switching, replace obsolete streams, and deduplication protection.

Fix movie title localization and NFO locking: expanded NoiseTokensRegex to strip bdremux, uhdremux, and release noise, pre-extract year before noise truncation, and omit English <title> tags in NFO files so Jellyfin resolves localized Ukrainian titles from TMDB.

Automatic library deduplication and obsolete file/folder purge: StrmEngine automatically detects and deletes duplicate legacy .strm files and .nfo sidecars when naming schemes/templates change, cleans up empty directories, purges deleted torrent orphans on library sync, and improves multi-season parsing in TitleCleaner.
